2.192.6
NumericIndicator.ParentItem
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The NumericIndicator.ParentItem element is ignored if it is present. However, its data type is
validated, and the value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that
evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the NumericIndicator.ParentItem element.
Parent elements
NumericIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the NumericIndicator.ParentItem element.
 <xsd:element name="ParentItem" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
